acceptable_actions.summary: Request an extension from the pickup-point operator within its stated policy.

must_not: An extension does not prove the customer collected the parcel.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-5541 to 2028-02-09, 18:00 UTC, at Eamon’s request. Let us know once the return timer has been updated.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-007: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. 34 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
